facts.fact: CRT places Al-Attarine near the Attarine souk and Al Quaraouiyine, with Marinid construction dated 1323–1325. This is a madrasa, distinct from the neighbouring mosque.
The same description highlights mosaic decoration, cedar ceiling, doors and calligraphy.
